name: inferred-cxx26
description: C++26 alignment (fix plan 2026-09-26 §9): sources nothing describes are read with the newest standard the compiler reading them takes, C++26 for the semantic kit (clang 23, libc++ 23), where 0.0.4 read them as C++23 and C++26 library names were missing (`std::saturating_add`). C++26 language features in a module's interface and in its importer, `import std` under C++26, and the standard in the status. (Contracts, P2900, are not in clang 23: `contract_assert` is colored by the VS Code grammar only, and code using contracts shows clang's errors.)
